Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it. We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably. Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There s still so much to build, and we d like your help with it. About this role Thousands of developers around the world use Ably s SDKs and APIs to power realtime features in their applications. The Developer Experience team is responsible for ensuring that Ably is a platform that exemplifies great developer experience, and is a reference point that other companies aspire to. As our Senior Developer Experience Writer, you’ll be contributing directly to this goal; helping developers to quickly understand Ably, build confidently and ultimately succeed with the platform. At its core, this is an AI-focussed role; you’ll be in charge of  setting up the foundations that empower engineers to produce first-class developer documentation with AI at scale. You’ll use AI to automate checks, maintain quality, and allow for rapid iteration in the content itself, as well as in the documentation platform. You’ll still be setting the standards for technical content across the business, and using your expertise to shape the information architecture. ACT. agency staat voor Advertising, Content and Technology. Wij geloven in een geïntegreerde advertising en content aanpak. Met onze ACT.vertising zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven communiceren op de korte én lange termijn. Inmiddels werken we met +/- 30 mensen op mooie accounts als Noordhoff, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Odido, Ben, PwC, Daimler, Histor, en Het Prinses Maxima Centrum. En we zijn nu op zoek naar een Social producer om onze social content elke dag scherper, sneller en beter te maken! Taken Over de rol Als Social Producer ben jij de motor achter onze social contentproductie. Je regelt alles rondom shoots: begroting, planning, crew, locaties, materialen en de coördinatie op de draaidag zelf. Jij houdt overzicht, denkt vooruit en lost problemen op voordat het problemen wórden. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time. What You'll Do Build and run the backend services and data pipelines that ingest, validate and process music deliveries from partners, covering audio, metadata, lyrics and new content types Own large parts of the ingestion pipeline and lead technical work as we add video, richer partner data and other new content Make ingestion more reliable, catch data quality problems at the point of entry, and improve the operational tooling around the pipeline Design and evolve APIs and schemas that other teams depend on, keeping contracts stable and backward compatible Help move validation towards real time and make Silk Road a well-documented, self-serve platform Deliver roadmap work, take part in planning, review code, and share on-call Work with Content Ops, operations tooling teams, partner teams and the product teams that build on our content Who You Are You have strong experience building and operating backend services and data pipelines in production

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Content Platform
jobs.description: Content Platform is the foundation of Spotify’s experiences. We ensure our vast catalog of music, podcasts, audiobooks, video, and creator data is trusted, safe, and ready to power innovation across Spotify. Our work spans content governance, platform safety, metadata, and machine learning systems that enable experiences such as Music Quiz , Playlist Mixes , Save to Spotify and SongDNA . Every day, our platform helps teams across Spotify build better products for millions of listeners and creators. As a Principal Product Managers you will own strategy directly. In this role, you’ll shape long-term direction, partner closely with engineering, machine learning, design, and business leaders, and deliver platform capabilities that have company-wide impact. What You'll Do Define and evolve product strategy for your domain using customer insights, data, and long-term platform thinking. Lead complex product initiatives from early discovery through delivery in partnership with engineering, machine learning, data science, and design teams. Partner with machine learning engineers to shape model strategy, training data, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop systems. Collaborate with stakeholders across Spotify to align priorities, influence roadmaps, and drive platform investments that create lasting value. Make thoughtful product decisions by balancing customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform health. Champion platform safety, trust, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence as Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow. Help teams prioritize work that delivers the greatest long-term impact while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes. Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress clearly across technical and executive audiences. jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.
